What I did

Designed a 150 response evaluation set Structured evaluation criteria Classified errors by type & severity Prepared data in Excel & Power Query Built DAX measures for QA metrics Built the interactive Power BI dashboard

Key insights

  • 150 evaluations analyzed across five task categories
  • Overall AI response pass rate of 58.7%
  • Major errors accounted for 20.7% of evaluations
  • Error analysis flagged where guidelines or model tuning could help

Business value: this project turns structured AI evaluation data into actionable quality insights, reflecting practical skills in LLM evaluation, data annotation, quality assurance, error analysis, data visualization, and AI data quality monitoring.
